ORDINANCE NO.7
(Series 2026)
AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CODE SECTION 10.18.060 OF THE GEORGETOWN
MUNICIPAL CODE CONCERNING HAUL ROUTE REGULATION PERMIT
CONDITIONS
WHEREAS, the Town of Georgetown is a Colorado municipal corporation operating
under a Territorial Charter and governed by its Board of Selectmen; and
WHEREAS, the Georgetown Board of Selectmen ("Board") is authorized by the
Territorial Charter and the Colorado Revised Statutes to enact ordinances for the preservation of
the public health, safety, and welfare; and
WHEREAS, in the exercise of this authority, the Board has previously adopted Chapter
18 of Title 10 of the Municipal Code, (the "Code") entitled "haul route regulations," and
WHEREAS, while the existing permit framework for haul route regulation provides a
foundation for regulating hauling activities,
increasing levels of commercial hauling
and construction-related traffic warrant additional permit requirements to ensure that
roadway impacts, traffic conflicts, and maintenance costs are appropriately addressed; and
WHEREAS, in order to accomplish these purposes, the Board wishes to amend Chapter
18 of Title 10 of the Code accordingly.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED BY THE BOARD OF SELECTMEN
OF THE TOWN OF GEORGETOWN, COLORADO:
Section 1. Section 10.18.020 of the Code is amended to read:
10.18.020 - Applicability and scope.
(a) These regulations shall apply to all activities involving truck haul activities
through the Town using trucks in excess of twenty-four (24) feet total length and with
ten (10) or more wheels, or for any trip involving an oversize load. For the purposes
of this Chapter 18, "oversize load" shall be as defined by the then-current regulations
of the Colorado Department of Transportation, but not greater than twenty-four (24)
feet or one hundred six (106) tons GVW.
(b) THE TOWN ADMINISTRATOR IS AUTHORIZED TO IMPLEMENT AND
REVISE, AS NECESSARY, THE "PERMIT APPLICATION FOR DESIGNATED
TRUCK HAUL ROUTE" ADMINISTRATIVELY USED BY THE TOWN TO
IMPLEMENT THIS CHAPTER 18.
Section 2. Section 10.18.030 is amended by the addition of a new subsection (c) to read:
10.18.030 - Designated haul route, scheduling and limitations.
